(Currently Amended) Claim 7: A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a regimen to a subject that has been pre-determined to have a risk of developing glaucoma.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a regimen to a subject that has been identified to be experiencing ocular hypertension.
